historical_verdicts_unchanged: R1 weight1 FAIL; R2 halfweight registered PASS with dense-measurement limitation
question: Does the fixed halfweight target-aware Japanese-input intervention generalize to an independent news/wiki text corpus, using dense fixed-target English measurement and Japanese retention measured after English learning?

data.source: UD English/Japanese/Russian PUD r2.16; original texts only, not syntactic annotations
data.split: Group parallel sentence IDs by original document. Unite documents with same-language normalized character-5gram Jaccard >=0.8. SHA256 of R3_PUD_2026_09_09: plus canonical document-cluster ID modulo 10: 0 evaluation, 1 unused reserve, 2..9 training.
data.normalization_for_model: NFC exact # text = field; exclude Japanese text_en and Russian english_text companion comments and all annotations. Newline-separated training sentences.
data.evaluation: Score each UTF-8 target byte except the first byte of each sentence exactly once, sentence-separated 128-position causal blocks, right padding masked from loss; full fixed evaluation split at every English update.
data.scope: One prespecified group holdout conditional-seed study, not a 10-fold UD parsing benchmark. Parallel translated source texts and fixed article sample limit external validity. No claim of semantic decontamination.

model.tokenizer: fixed UTF-8 bytes, no corpus fitting
model.backend: CPU, deterministic PyTorch algorithms, one PyTorch thread/job

common_batches: Same JA phase1 batches for all four Student conditions; identical English phase2 batches for all five arms. Teacher JA slots match between T_EN and T_RU. Record hashes of actual model update inputs per stage/condition, not just regenerated schedules.

primary.hitting_time: First actually observed integer update at or below target; evaluate every update including 0, no interpolation. Crossing state saved and Japanese loss evaluated on that exact state.
primary.saving: Per seed 1 - TEN hitting updates / TJA hitting updates; tokens per update = 2048
efficacy_gates: all ten seeds have finite positive TJA hitting times and TEN target attainment by update600
at least9/10 favorable paired times, one-sided sign test <=0.05
descriptive paired-seed percentile 95% bootstrap lower bound >=0.05; 10000 draws, numpy default_rng seed 98309
retention_gates: phase1 ratio of mean Japanese NLL TEN/TJA <=1.01
at the first English-target crossing for each arm, ratio of mean Japanese NLL TEN/TJA <=1.01
TEN mean Japanese NLL at its English-target crossing <=1.05 times TEN mean phase1 Japanese NLL
primary.joint_utility: PASS requires all efficacy, retention and integrity gates. Fully observed failed gates imply FAIL; missing executions or invalid measurement imply UNCERTAIN. A missing crossing never becomes a favorable seed and is never silently omitted.

secondary.fixed_interval: Integer first crossings of3.25 and3.00 nats/byte; valid for mechanistic interval analysis only if both arms start strictly above3.25 and both cross3.00. Report invalid/censored counts without clipping away starting differences.
other_outputs: English and Japanese NLL after600 English updates
Japanese NLL at equal English target and at equal fixed training budget
full raw English curves, saved base/teacher/phase1/target/final states
paired-seed uncertainty and byte-class loss decomposition of endpoint models as descriptive diagnostics only
secondary.no_metric_selection: Secondary outcomes do not repair a failed primary or joint utility gate. The primary hitting-time effect can include knowledge prepositioning; it is not pure learning-rate change.

integrity: verify exact source and prepared-data hashes
no original article or defined near duplicate crosses train/eval
no companion English comment enters JA input
finite losses and exact expected curve grids
actual batch hashes agree across paired arms
all ten seed identities unique and fixed; search prior published result seeds
recompute decisions from raw curves and Japanese metrics from checkpoints
stopping: Exactly ten seeds and one already fixed hidden weight0.5. Finish all600 English updates per arm regardless of intermediate effects. No rescue seed, corpus substitution, threshold relaxation, loss-weight or model search. Infrastructure fixes must be recorded without suppressing prior outcomes. No work continues asynchronously after the reported session.
nonclaims: zero English-derived information in hidden targets
semantic ability measured by byte NLL alone
